scenes.heading: ✨ LETTER OF THE DAY ✨
scenes.narration: Look up in the sky! It's the very first letter of the alphabet! The Letter A!

scenes.heading: 🍎 A IS FOR APPLE!
scenes.narration: A says Ah, Ah, Apple! Big, red, and juicy! Take a bite! Munch munch munch!

scenes.heading: 🐊 A IS FOR ALLIGATOR!
scenes.narration: A says Ah, Ah, Alligator! Chomping happily with a friendly smile! Chomp chomp!

scenes.heading: 🌟 YOU DID IT!
scenes.narration: You learned Letter A! Can you find something around you that starts with A? You are so smart!
